description: This file contains a test class 'OAuth2Cest' for testing OAuth2 authentication APIs, including scenarios for invalid login, invalid client details, grant type restrictions, and login with different OAuth2 grant types.

classes.name: OAuth2Cest
classes.description: Test class for OAuth2 token authentication scenarios using Codeception framework.

methods.name: TestScenarioInvalidLogin
methods.description: Tests the API response to invalid login credentials, expecting a 400 response code.

methods.name: TestScenarioInvalidClient
methods.description: Tests the API response when invalid client credentials are provided, expecting a 401 response code.

methods.name: TestScenarioGrantTypeNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that only allowed grant types are accepted, expecting a 400 response code for disallowed grant type.

methods.name: TestScenarioLoginWithPasswordGrant
methods.description: Tests successful login using password grant type to obtain a JWT token.

methods.name: TestScenarioLoginWithClientCredentialsGrant
methods.description: Tests login using client credentials grant type, then reverts to password grant login.
